name: Multi Retail Group Ltd
summary: Multi Retail Group Ltd. is a leading retail entity in Israel, offering an expansive range of products catering to home, garden, and vehicle needs through its ACE, AUTODEPOT, and Spetz brands. Its comprehensive inventory includes home improvement and maintenance essentials, a wide variety of electrical accessories, appliances, and electronics, alongside heating and cooling solutions. For outdoor living, the company provides garden furniture, pools, grilling equipment, camping and hiking gear, and general gardening supplies. The company also features a diverse selection of home furnishings, such as textiles, beds, sofas, tables, chairs, and decorative items. Its offerings extend to full bathroom and plumbing solutions, various storage and organizational units like cabinets and wardrobes, and a broad spectrum of building materials, paints, wallpapers, and specialized tools (power, hand, and technical). Additionally, customers can find automotive parts, including tires and batteries, car care accessories, and flooring options. The company further provides garage services. Beyond its retail operations, Multi Retail Group Ltd. manufactures various home and office furniture items, including cabinets, closets, and bookcases. Operating with 32 physical stores and two active e-commerce platforms, the company ensures widespread accessibility for its customers. Incorporated in 2016 as AS Capital Retail (2016) Ltd., the company rebranded to Multi Retail Group Ltd. in December 2021 and maintains its headquarters in Rishon Lezion, Israel.
